lines.text: Snail mucin or Centella? If your skin is red and angry, stop guessing.
Snail mucin is incredible for deep hydration and that glass skin glow.
But for redness and stinging, Centella Asiatica is the better-studied pick.
Spoiler: K-beauty's Cica is just Centella — same plant, different label.
So: Snail for glow. Centella for repair. Subscribe and let's simplify your skincare habits.
